name: database-client
description: Zero-credential, read-only-by-default database & middleware CLI for coding agents: discovers per-project env vars, inspects schema, runs queries, diagnoses locks/slow SQL, follows Redis Cluster redirects, and inspects Kafka topics/lag/messages across MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, SQLite, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, ClickHouse and Elasticsearch.
author: Wang Dong <wangdong4@gtht.com>
